note: Adapted from Constantino's (1995) revision of the genus Syntermes, originally in English. That work gives descriptions of the alate, the soldier and the major worker, together with soldier measurements (11 colonies, 11 soldiers: head length 6.30—7.10 mm, maximum head width 6.50—7.20 mm, head height without postmentum 3.70—4.30 mm, frontal tube length 0.27—0.42 mm, left mandible length 3.20—4.00 mm, left mandible curvature 1.40—2.00 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.76—1.09 mm). The original is an OCR text of a BHL scan, with some digits broken (e.g. “6.30-7. 10”), corrected here from the context; specimen and type-locality information has not been entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier distinguished from the other species of the genus by its large size, the head densely covered with fine long curled hairs, the very large spines on the pronotum and the meso- and metanotum, and the coarse mandibular teeth; close to large individuals of S. dirus in size and pilosity, but the latter is always smaller, has smaller mandibular teeth, and the apical cutting edge of the left mandible is distinctly S-shaped. Alate similar to S. dirus, but the pronotum is relatively wider and shorter, and the fontanelle is larger.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes small, diameter less than 1/4 of the head width; ocelli small, length about 1/10 of the head width; fontanelle large and round. Antennae 20-segmented. Anterolateral corners of the pronotum sharp and angular, the lateral margins rounded and converging posteriorly. Wings relatively short, the media and cubitus distinct apically. Head capsule with a few scattered very short hairs, postclypeus with 6—8 short hairs; outer margins of the pronotum hairy, the surface with only a few scattered hairs; posterior margin of the abdominal tergites with a row of hairs. Head and pronotum pale chestnut.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short and wide, the sides straight and converging anteriorly, the posterior margin evenly rounded. Frontal tube projecting. Lateral corners of the labrum obtuse. Antennae 20-segmented. Sides of the posterior part of the postmentum nearly parallel. Anterior margin of the pronotum concave (visible only in posterior view).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head length/head width ratio 0.79—1.02; left mandible M1—M2 distance/left mandible length ratio 0.23—0.33; head height/maximum head width ratio 0.56—0.60; left mandible width/length ratio 0.29—0.39.
